prompt.zh-TW: 北風單車行把店裡全部的單車賒銷給一家車隊，售價 {{money:e1.price}}，對方下個月付款。這是五步驟的步驟①：先預測下面五個數字各會怎麼變。
prompt.en: North Wind Cycles sells all its bicycles on credit to a cycling team for {{money:e1.price}}, payable next month. This is step 1 of the five-step check: first predict how each of the five figures below changes.

explanation.zh-TW: 賣出就認列收入，不必等收到錢：營業毛利增加 {{money:e1.grossProfit}}（售價 {{money:e1.price}} 減去存貨成本 {{money:e1.costOfAllInventory}}），本期淨利跟著增加同樣的金額。現金完全沒動，錢暫時掛在應收帳款；存貨則因為賣出而減少。
explanation.en: Revenue is recognised when the goods are sold, not when the money arrives: gross profit rises by {{money:e1.grossProfit}} (the price of {{money:e1.price}} less the inventory cost of {{money:e1.costOfAllInventory}}), and profit for the period rises by the same amount. Cash does not move at all; the money sits in trade receivables for now, and inventories fall because the goods have left.
